subject: Consortium RFP — Access Verification, SSO & Provisioning Clarifications
messages:
From: Alex Pruitt <alex.pruitt@consortium-fin.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Holt <dana.holt@consortium-fin.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T15:18:00Z
Subject: Consortium RFP — clarifications on SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the response packet you submitted with the RFP. The review team had a few follow-ups so we can sign off on the Identity & Access Controls section:

1) SSO: We need confirmation that Redwood supports both SAML 2.0 IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows, and whether OIDC Authorization Code with PKCE is supported for browser-based apps. Any limitations (e.g., attribute mapping, default nameID formats)?

2) Provisioning: For SCIM, do you support incremental syncs and bulk operations (endpoint details if possible)? Customers require user -> group membership propagation within 2 minutes for high-velocity onboarding.

3) RBAC & admin: We need a short matrix showing admin roles, privileges (create user, assign roles, revoke tokens), and whether delegated admin can be scoped to org units or specific models.

4) Audit & evidence: Please point us to sample audit artifacts (change timestamped entries, API logs for user provision events) and confirm retention period for admin/audit logs.

Can you get us a concise reply and any evidentiary attachments by EOD next Monday (2027-03-08)? Appreciate it — the security review is the last gating item for procurement.

Best,
Alex
Consortium Financial Services

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (solutions) for the technical specifics and Ben (sales) for procurement/next steps. We can meet the EOD Monday deadline.

Quick summary up front:
- SSO: Full SAML 2.0 support for both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows; OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE supported. We include configurable attribute mapping and support nameID in email or persistent formats.
- SCIM: Support for incremental (delta) syncs and bulk operations; our typical propagation tail for user-to-group is sub-2 minutes for most customers, and we provide webhook hooks for near-real-time events.
- RBAC: Built-in role hierarchy with owner, admin, operator, auditor; delegated admin scoping available by tenant and by model group.
- Audit: Admin and provisioning events retained for 13 months by default (extendable). We will attach sanitized log samples and a short RBAC matrix.

We'll follow up in-line with the detailed answers and attachments.

Thanks,

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Consortium RFP — clarifications on SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence

Alex/Dana — technical detail below, pasted for traceability. See also attached evidence bundle and RBAC matrix.

1) SSO (SAML / OIDC)
- SAML: We support SAML 2.0 both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated. We accept HTTP-Redirect and HTTP-POST bindings for AuthnRequest. Supported NameID formats: emailAddress, persistent, and transient. Attribute mapping: customer-configurable map; default attributes include: email, givenName, familyName, groups. Signature/Encryption: we support signed assertions and encrypted response handling; consumer-side certificate rotation supported with overlap window for key rollover.
- OIDC: Authorization Code flow with PKCE supported (web + mobile). We also support client credentials for service-to-service tokens and refresh tokens per RFC. Claims mapping is configurable; we can map sub/email/roles claims to internal identity fields.

2) SCIM provisioning
- Protocol: SCIM 2.0 endpoint supporting POST (create), PUT/PATCH (update), DELETE (delete).
- Bulk + delta: We implement the SCIM bulk extension for batch ops and a delta token for incremental syncs. Typical provisioning throughput on our managed control plane supports thousands of operations/min.
- Latency SLA: For standard dedicated customers, user->group membership propagation typically completes within 30–90 seconds in steady state; we quoted <2 minutes for burst scenarios and provide webhook event fan-out for immediate downstream processing.
- Retries/error handling: Built-in idempotency keys for bulk operations; detailed error codes in responses to assist reconciliation.

3) RBAC & admin scoping
- Roles: Owner (full tenant privileges), Admin (manage users/roles, deploy policies), Operator (manage deployments, can restart/pin model versions), Auditor (read-only access to logs/metrics).
- Privilege matrix: attached "RBAC_Recommendation_Matrix.xlsx" maps discrete operations to roles.
- Delegated admin: Can constrain Admin scope to org units (by attribute/OU), environment (prod/staging), and model groups. We support per-model ACLs and can grant temporary elevation via time-limited tokens.

4) Audit & evidence
- Log retention: Admin/audit logs retained 13 months by default on hosted plans; Dedicated/Private customers can configure retention to meet compliance needs.
- Artifacts: Attached are redacted samples: API provisioning logs, SAML assertion validation events, and an example audit trail for a role assignment (timestamps, actor, IP, request id).

Security notes: Customer-managed KMS is supported for Private deployments; HSM-backed keys available for FIPS requirements.

If you want, we can provide a short runbook that walks through a SCIM bulk re-sync and a sample IdP metadata exchange.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
